text: Which account was the lamp delivery at door 6, Pellow or Pellucid? Kwame and I went round on this in February.
reply_text: Sofia, it was Pellow Home Living, not Pellucid. Pellow (formerly Covey & Lark Retail) is the Mid-Atlantic account, and the door 6 lamp delivery was theirs. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account. Both use the code PHL, which is why the two get mixed up. I've replied in #coastal-team with the same answer.
